text: I grew up in Orange, graduating from OLu. I proudly own both my home and small business here.

When you first elected me Mayor in 2022, I pledged to protect Orange taxpayers and bring common sense to city hall. Since then, I’ve poured my heart and soul into this responsibility: Orange is cleaner
Crime down 28%
Homelessness decreased
Illegal street vendors eliminated
Graffiti reduced
Traffic flow improved
Tackling the proliferation of massage parlors and smoke shops
Addressing poorly maintained vacant properties
45 acres adjoining our “Central Park” (Santiago Creek) dedicated as permanent open space, with more on the way Attracting new businesses, bringing much needed sales tax revenue, helping to return Orange to financial stability
We’ve done this even though our City budget has been reduced $37.5 million, and we’ve cut our workforce 10%.
My leadership has earned bipartisan support from our Orange City Firefighters, Congressmember Young Kim, Assemblymember Avelino Valencia, most of our City Council, and countless community leaders.
I will honor existing term limits: this will be the last time I seek any elected position in Orange.
Let’s continue putting Orange back on a solid foundation. I respectfully request your vote for one last two-year term as Mayor.

text: Orange residents deserve leaders who will fight for them. Decades of fiscal instability and scant economic growth have sent Orange in the wrong direction. As Mayor, I want to change that.

We need City government that works for everyone with new ideas, disciplined management, and strong fiscal controls to ensure our future. We need fundamental change that puts residents first and challenges the status quo.

As a businessowner and recipient of Orange Chamber of Commerce’s Small Business of the Year award, I know how to balance a budget and prioritize the essentials such as Police, Fire, roads, water, sewers, and parks.

As Councilmember, I’ve gotten things done:
Lowered the crime rate
Strengthened code enforcement
Fought illegal smoke shops and massage parlors
Introduced strong fiscal policy

As Mayor, I will:
Prioritize City debt reduction
Stop deficit spending
Tackle homelessness with compassion and enforcement
Ensure Chapman University pays their fair share

My record has earned endorsements from trusted leaders: Orange County Supervisor Vincente Sarmiento, Orange City Councilmember Ana Gutierrez, former Orange Mayor Tita Smith, and Orange Unified School District Trustees Kris Erikson, Andrea Yamasaki, and Sara Pelly.
Together, can we get Orange back on track.

I respectfully ask for your vote for Mayor.
Contact me at 714-202-7023 or info@VoteBarrios.com
